additional_info.body:
Hello Magnus,
I hope you are doing well.
We appreciate your patience as we work to resolve the issue you have reported. We have reviewed the AWS logs from the past four weeks and observed that DC 2 has been unavailable during this period. Please note that DC2 was not intentionally deactivated.
We recommend checking and possibly considering the replacement of KF11.
This is the communication issue between state monitor and PLC, so we recommend you carry Spare Ethernet cable.
